entries.jp: 井伊の天歌に敗れ\n地に伏した五人
entries.en:
Defeated by Ii's
Heaven's Song,
the five lay fallen
on the ground.

entries.jp:
魂は天歌と共に
天へと散り
抜け殻となった体だけが
そこにあった
entries.en:
Their souls had
scattered to the
heavens with
Heaven's Song;
only their bodies
remained,
empty husks.

entries.jp: 天守閣に立つ\n井伊の影が\n江戸を覆いつくす
entries.en:
The shadow of Ii,
standing atop the
castle keep, fell
over all of Edo.

entries.jp: 志士共よ\n貴様らの希望は潰えた
entries.en: Rebels...\nyour hopes\nare crushed.

entries.jp: 我は宣言しよう\n新たな世　泰平の世は\nここから始まるのだ
entries.en:
I hereby declare
it: a new age, an
age of peace,
begins here.

entries.jp: ふふふ　ははははは\nハーハッハッハ！
entries.en: Heh heh heh...\nHa ha ha ha ha...\nHA HA HA HA!

entries.jp: 志士との\n壮絶な戦いから\n三年――
entries.en: Three years after\nthe fierce battle\nwith the rebels--

entries.jp: 直弼ー！
entries.en: Naosuke!

entries.jp: 慶喜様ー！\nいかがですか
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama!\nHow is it?

entries.jp: 馬の稽古みたいだよ\nぐるぐるぐるぐる楽しいよー
entries.en:
It's like riding
practice! Round
and round and
round, it's so fun!

entries.jp: ああ　まさしく天使
entries.en: Ahh, truly\nan angel.

entries.jp: あっち\n今度はあっちに乗ろう！
entries.en: That one!\nLet's ride\nthat one next!

entries.jp: おっと　そっちは\n年齢制限がありますから\n一緒でないと乗れませんよ
entries.en:
Oh, careful. That
one has an age
limit, so you can't
ride it unless I'm
with you.

entries.jp: 直弼ー\n早く早くー！
entries.en: Naosuke!\nHurry, hurry!

entries.jp: 止まる間もなく\n駆け出す慶喜
entries.en: Yoshinobu dashed\noff without a\nmoment's pause.

entries.jp: 目の前には\n波のようにうねる線路と\n山のごとき高さの建物
entries.en:
Before them:
tracks that rolled
like waves, and a
structure as tall
as a mountain.

entries.jp: ぎゃー　止めてー\n直弼ー直弼ー
entries.en: Gyaah! Make it\nstop! Naosuke!\nNaosuke!

entries.jp: 徳川の男子たる者\nこの程度で音を上げては\nいけません！
entries.en:
A son of the
Tokugawa must
not cry out
over something
like this!

entries.jp: 凄まじい速度で右に左に\n体が揺さぶられる
entries.en:
At terrifying
speed, they
were flung
left and right.

entries.jp:
必死に井伊へ
しがみつく慶喜
井伊の口の端には
喜色が浮かんでいる
entries.en:
Yoshinobu clung
desperately to
Ii. At the corner
of Ii's mouth, a
look of delight
appeared.

entries.jp: うーわー\n地面が地面が！\n空が空が！
entries.en:
Waaah! The
ground, the
ground! The
sky, the sky!

entries.jp: 慶喜様\n腹部に力を入れるのです\n天歌を制すもの天地を制す
entries.en:
Yoshinobu-sama,
tighten your
stomach! He who
masters Heaven's
Song masters
heaven and earth!

entries.jp: 直弼～～
entries.en: Naosukeee...

entries.jp: 何よりも……
entries.en: More than\nanything...

entries.jp: 直弼　そなたがいてくれる
entries.en: Naosuke, you're\nhere with me.

entries.jp: 慶喜様
entries.en: Yoshinobu-sama...

entries.jp: 井伊の傍らへ\n寄りそう慶喜
entries.en: Yoshinobu\nnestled close\nbeside Ii.

entries.jp: ゆっくりと流れる時の中\n心地よい温もりが\n二人を包む
entries.en:
As time flowed
slowly by, a
gentle warmth
wrapped around
the two of them.

entries.jp: 直弼　これからも\n予の側に　いておくれ
entries.en: Naosuke, stay\nby my side from\nnow on, too.

entries.jp: もちろんです\n私は慶喜様と共に\nいつまでも……
entries.en:
Of course. I will
be with you,
Yoshinobu-sama,
forever...

entries.jp: 約束だよ！\nずっと　ずっとだよ！
entries.en: Promise! Forever\nand ever!

entries.jp: ええ　ずっとおりますよ
entries.en: Yes, I'll always\nbe here.

entries.jp: 貴様　何をやっている
entries.en: You. What are\nyou doing?

entries.jp: ……何とは
entries.en: ...What do\nyou mean?

entries.jp: 我らとの契約　徳川の世\n天歌泰平の世界
entries.en:
Our pact. The
Tokugawa
reign. A world
of Heaven's
Song Peace.

entries.jp: それを血迷うたか\n徳川園（ランド）の建設\n名君慶喜の治世だと？
entries.en:
Have you lost
your mind?
Building
Tokugawa
Land? The reign
of Yoshinobu
the wise ruler?

entries.jp: ふっ　知らんな
entries.en: Heh. Not\nmy concern.

entries.jp: 我は徳川の世など\nどうでもいいのだ\n慶喜様が幸せであれば良い
entries.en:
I care nothing for
the Tokugawa
reign. So long as
Yoshinobu-sama
is happy, that is
enough.

entries.jp:
孤独の淵よりお救いし
お守りする
あの方の望みを
叶えるのが我の望み
entries.en:
To save him from
the depths of
loneliness, to
protect him, to
grant his wishes--
that is my wish.

entries.jp: 貴様……
entries.en: You...

entries.jp: 怨霊から電光が\nほとばしり\n井伊を襲う
entries.en:
Lightning burst
from the
vengeful spirits
and struck at Ii.

entries.jp: だが電光は\n体に触れる直前で\n霧散した
entries.en:
But the lightning
dissipated just
before it touched
him.

entries.jp: 何
entries.en: What?

entries.jp: この目を捧げ\n交わした呪……
entries.en: A curse sealed\nwith the offering\nof this eye...

entries.jp: それだけで　いつまでも\n我を縛れると思うてか
entries.en:
Did you truly
think that alone
could bind me
forever?

entries.jp: 慶喜様への愛の前に\n貴様の呪など無力
entries.en:
Before my
love for
Yoshinobu-sama,
your curse
is powerless.

entries.jp: 井伊から放たれた鬼気に\n怨霊の影がたじろぐ
entries.en:
The shadow of
the spirits
flinched before
the fierce aura
Ii unleashed.

entries.jp: 身の程を知れ！
entries.en: Know your place!

entries.jp: 我こそは井伊直弼\n慶喜様の大老にして\n天下を治むる者ぞ！
entries.en:
I am Naosuke Ii!
Great Elder to
Yoshinobu-sama,
and he who
rules the land!

entries.jp: 井伊と怨霊の間で\n力が光となり交差する
entries.en:
Between Ii and
the spirits, their
powers turned to
light and clashed.

entries.jp: ぐごぐごおお……
entries.en: Gugogugooo...

entries.jp: ぬうん！
entries.en: Hnnngh!

entries.jp: 轟音が響き渡り\n光が世界を満たした
entries.en:
A thunderous
roar rang out,
and light filled
the world.

entries.jp: 光が消えた時\nそこには瞑目する\n井伊の姿があった
entries.en:
When the light
faded, Ii stood
there with his
eyes closed.

entries.jp: 静かに眠るが良い\n徳川は……慶喜様の世は\nこの直弼が引き受けた
entries.en:
Rest quietly.
The Tokugawa...
Yoshinobu-sama's
reign... I,
Naosuke, shall
take it upon
myself.

entries.jp:
徳川の世は
これよりさらに
三百年の間
続くこととなる
entries.en:
The Tokugawa
reign would go on
for another three
hundred years,

entries.jp: 徳川園（ランド）の\n世界進出と共に
entries.en: as Tokugawa\nLand expanded\nacross the world.

entries.jp: ＢＡＤ　ＥＮＤ…？
entries.en: BAD END...?
